style.global_prompt: cinematic film still, warm golden-hour light, dry rural Indian village road, lush mango trees, soft dust in the air, gentle glow, documentary color grade, 35mm film grain, serene atmosphere
style.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, deformed face, extra limbs, bad hands, watermark, text, captions, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, fisheye, dutch angle, flicker, morphing

character.physical: elderly Indian traveler, ~70 years old, warm brown skin, deep-set kind eyes, white beard, white cotton dhoti, cream kurta, pale orange turban, simple cloth bundle on a bamboo stick over his shoulder, barefoot
character.identity: the same old traveler appears in ALL scenes exactly as described; keep his face, clothes and bundle identical in every shot

scenes.cam: wide establishing aerial shot slowly pushing forward
scenes.visual: empty dusty village road at golden hour with a lone old traveler walking away from camera
scenes.narration: सुनिए कबीर दास की एक प्रेरणादायक कहानी।

scenes.cam: low angle medium shot tilting up, slow zoom
scenes.visual: the old traveler stops and looks up at a gigantic tall date palm with a long bare brown trunk, spiky leaves high at the top, harsh sun
scenes.narration: एक गर्म दोपहर में, एक राहगीर को रास्ते में एक विशाल खजूर का पेड़ मिला।

scenes.visual: the traveler sits resting his back against the bare trunk of the tall date palm, wiping sweat, no shade around, blazing sunlight
scenes.narration: वह पेड़ कितना बड़ा था, पर उसकी छाया नहीं थी।

scenes.cam: high angle reverse shot looking up
scenes.visual: close framing of the traveler craning his neck toward a cluster of ripe golden dates far up in the palm crown, out of reach, hand lifted
scenes.narration: फल भी बहुत ऊँचे थे, हाथ की पहुँच से परे।

scenes.visual: the traveler walks away from the tall bare palm toward a small humble leafy neem tree in a green field ahead, birds resting on it
scenes.narration: थका हुआ राहगीर आगे बढ़ा, और एक छोटे से नीम के पेड़ के पास पहुँचा।

scenes.cam: low wide shot under the canopy, slow push-in
scenes.visual: the traveler sits comfortably under the low spreading branches of the small neem tree, dense cool shade covering him fully, relief on his face, dappled light
scenes.narration: छोटे से पेड़ की घनी, ठंडी छाया में बैठते ही उसे राहत मिली।

scenes.visual: a village boy and two villagers join the traveler under the neem tree, sharing water and laughing in the cool shade, warm community moment
scenes.narration: आस-पास के लोग भी आ गए, छाया में बैठकर सबने विश्राम किया।

scenes.visual: in the far background the enormous bare date palm stands alone at the edge of the field, in the foreground the small leafy neem tree shelters the happy group of villagers, strong visual contrast
scenes.narration: पर उस विशाल खजूर के पेड़ के पास कोई नहीं रुका।

scenes.visual: a serene elderly philosopher-saint in simple white robes with a wooden walking stick approaches the group under the neem tree, children tugging his robe affectionately, gentle smile
scenes.narration: तभी कबीर दास वहाँ आए, और यह दोहा सुनाया।

scenes.visual: the sage raises one finger, speaking to the villagers gathered under the neem tree, late afternoon light streaming through the leaves, storytelling mood
scenes.narration: बड़ा हुआ तो क्या हुआ, जैसे पेड़ खजूर। पंथी को छाया नहीं, फल लागे अति दूर।

scenes.cam: extreme close-up of the face, slow push-in
scenes.visual: close-up of the wise sage's weathered kind face narrating, eyes twinkling, villagers and the old traveler listening around him, golden light
scenes.narration: अर्थात, बड़ा होने से क्या फ़ायदा, जो किसी के काम न आए।

scenes.cam: ultimate wide shot at dusk, slow pull-back
scenes.visual: peaceful dusk, sunset sky orange and purple, in the foreground the small neem tree glowing warm with villagers still gathered beneath it, in the far distance the lone tall bare date palm silhouetted against the fading light
scenes.narration: विद्या और धन वही सार्थक हैं, जो दूसरों के काम आएँ।
